answer: The system ties each agent’s reward to a delta‑adjusted vesting curve: newly minted identities receive a sable‑colored token batch that unlocks only a fraction each epoch, and the unlocked amount follows a sonnet‑shaped schedule that tapers to zero after a fixed horizon. To claim the next tranche an agent must post a proof of work whose cost rises linearly with the number of active identities it controls, so a Sybil farm must expend real compute and token fees for every fake node.
